title: Merge queue
description: A merged PR receives an atomic item-owned merge receipt and landing stamps before the holder is notified. Worker closeout still owns results and verification. A queue entry marked UNMERGEABLE stops the landing even before GitHub removes it. An open PR whose merge state GitHub reports as unknown is still a pending landing, not a stop: GitHub reports unknown while it recomputes, including mid-merge after it clears the queue entry and merge-when-ready. The landing notice names rebase onto the base, verification, and governed merge re-entry.
